description.value:
Prerequisites Du'ulora Kalashtar heritage

Frequency once per hour

As a creature succumbs to its feelings of anger and hate, your control over them grows. Choose a hostile foe within 30 feet, that creature must make a Will save against your innate occult DC.
Critical Success The creature resists your taunt.
Success On the creature's turn, it must spend 1 of its actions to attack you if it can, or in the pursuit of being able to attack you.
Failure The creature becomes @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. On the creature's turn, it must spend 2 of its actions to attack you if it can, or in the pursuit of being able to attack you.
Critical Failure The creature becomes @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. On the creature's turn, it must spend all of its actions to attack you if it can, or in the pursuit of being able to attack you.
